**Standards: PASS. Spec: PASS.** The only tracked diff is the one-line update to `docs/model-routing.md`. It accurately reports **PARTIAL / HTTP 400**, no retry or fallback, and an unknown cause because the provider body was not retained. The evidence supports those claims.

The partial-result verifier checks recorded artifacts and Git state; the request-shape verifier uses synthetic auth and an intercepted synthetic response. Neither makes a real runtime request or reads real credentials. The retention script is mutating by design; I inspected it but did not run it. No scripts or live driver were run.
